definitions.gloss: sales; sales performance; how well something sells
definitions.explanation: The pace or trend of sales for a product. Indicates whether something is selling well or poorly.

examples.japanese: {新商品|しんしょうひん}の{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きがいい。
examples.english: The new product is selling well.

examples.japanese: {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きが{落|お}ちてきた。
テレビで{紹介|しょうかい}されてから、この{本|ほん}の{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きが{急激|きゅうげき}に{伸|の}びた。
examples.english: After being featured on TV, sales of this book grew rapidly.

notes:
{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き is a compound noun formed from {売|う}れる (to sell) and {行|ゆ}き (course, trend). It focuses on the trend or pace of sales rather than the total sales figure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きがいい (selling well)
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きが{悪|わる}い (selling poorly)
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きが{伸|の}びる (sales grow)
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きが{落|お}ちる (sales decline)
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きを{見|み}る (to watch sales performance)

RELATED WORDS:
{売上|うりあげ} (sales revenue) refers to the actual monetary amount of sales. {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き refers more to the pace and trend — whether items are flying off the shelves or sitting unsold.
